system.description:
CLASS FLOURISH GYMNAST

You change your momentum into forceful strikes.

Prerequisites Vaulting Momentum, Acrobatics 8 ranks

Action 2 AP

Make a Jump or Tumble check as part of this action. If successful, you may immediately make a melee Strike at the end of the movement:

- If you moved at least 10 feet, add +1d4 precision damage.

- If your check result is a critical, this damage increases to 2d4.

Automated: press Use (2 AP, the whole action): choose High Jump, Long Jump or Tumble and make the check, no further AP. On a Success or better the movement is armed free of AP — drag your token — and the card offers the melee Strike (no AP) for when you have moved: +1d4 precision damage if you moved at least 10 feet during the action, 2d4 if the check was a critical. A creature immune to precision takes none of it; one resisting it, half the dice.
